PluginData.Author: lolifamily
PluginData.Tooltip: Display and type Chinese and Japanese in any UI language.
PluginData.Description:
Display and type Chinese and Japanese in any UI language, without translating anything.
Missing characters come from the game's own Chinese and Japanese fonts: all common Simplified Chinese and kana, about 3/4 of common kanji and 2/3 of common Traditional Chinese; the rest show as boxes.
Also fixes the game's IME support: - the candidate window shows at the caret - Enter confirms the word, not also the dialog - Enter, Tab, undo and redo work in multi-line boxes like the Programmable Block editor - undo takes back a whole word from the IME - Up and Down keep the caret's column after typing - mods receive the typed text - IME work now runs on the game thread: no crashes while composing, no garbled text at low FPS - text box focus changes no longer wait for the render thread: no hitch, no freeze with -render_sync - no system-wide keyboard hook, which delayed every keystroke in other programs
In every UI language, undo and redo leave the caret where the text changed.
